activity_summary: At the shop bench you mended Hamnet's small wooden wheel while Judith questioned every decision. Joan laid down a scrap of leather that made the repair possible, told you to use the heel of the knife, and declined your attempt to turn her help into a joke. The wheel turned unevenly, and it turned every time. Hamnet ran it down the yard. Judith said that unevenly was her prediction from the start.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Fitted the leather with the heel of the knife and tapped the pin home.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the rim and ran the wheel down the yard.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Questioned every step and claimed the uneven turn.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Supplied the scrap, named the heel of the knife, and refused the joke.

facets.activity: Mended Hamnet's wheel with Joan's scrap of leather

quotes.speaker: joan_shakespeare
quotes.text: Wrap the pin, not the wood. Three turns and pare the tail flush.

quotes.speaker: joan_shakespeare
quotes.text: Keep thy speeches for Shoreditch and cut the leather straight.

quotes.speaker: judith_shakespeare
quotes.text: I told you from the start it would turn unevenly, and so it does.

quotes.speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
quotes.text: It did turn. It turned too far, and it came back.
